journeys.t: Add a student and give access
journeys.d: New active institution → add a student → add the course code → give the eligible experiment → Student access and Content access agree.

steps.t: Add a student in People (for example Rahul Verma, GIT-2026-0418)
Add your course code for ME ZG523 on Content access › Course codes
Give the student Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger and confirm
Open Student access and Content access: both count the same students

journeys.t: Import students from a CSV file
journeys.d: Invalid file → row errors block the import → corrected file → import → a duplicate e-mail is refused and nothing existing changes.

steps.t: Choose godavari-me-zg523.csv and check it: rows with errors stop the import
Choose the corrected file and check it again
Try to add a student whose e-mail is already in People: it is refused

journeys.t: Create a group and give it access
journeys.d: Create a group → manage its members → give it an experiment → withdraw one identified individual grant.

steps.t: Give the group Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger
Withdraw Rahul Verma’s individual grant on Student access

journeys.t: Add a faculty member and assign a course
journeys.d: Add faculty → assign a course in Faculty courses → the faculty record and Faculty courses agree.

steps.t: Assign them ME ZG523 in Faculty courses
Open their faculty record: it lists the course

journeys.t: Ask BITS and forward a device request
journeys.d: Request a renewal or more licences and inspect its status → forward Rahul Verma’s device transfer.

steps.t: Ask BITS for a renewal or more licences
Open the request and check where it stands
Forward Rahul Verma’s device request to BITS
